The attempt to attach the "ops-reader" role to the "audit-endpoint" has failed repeatedly. This might be due to a misconfiguration or an access restriction. Since the system does not allow granting permissions outside the "ops-*" namespace and we cannot extend the scope, I will escalate the ticket due to the inability to meet the precondition for attaching the required role. 

I will close the ticket with the resolution set to 'escalated'.
